programme.title: Z archiwum WRC – WRC 2016 Season Review
programme.desc: A series dedicated to the world rally championship. The authors of the program present the profiles of the greatest drivers, recall famous moments of past seasons and show interesting comparisons. Summary of the prestigious series of the WRC 2016 World Rally Championship. The 44th season ultimately consisted of 13 rounds. One round – China's September rally – was canceled. Sebastian Ogier won the championship title. For the 32-year-old Frenchman, it was the fourth championship in a row and the fourth in his career. In total, in the 2016 season, the driver from Gap won 6 victories. The championship title in the manufacturers' category was won by the Volkswagen factory team for the fourth time in a row. programme.title: New Zealand: Mythical Islands – Drift | E01
programme.desc: Viewers have the opportunity to better understand the nature and geographical conditions of the island chain, isolated from other ecosystems. The local forests are inhabited by, among others: predators from the Jurassic period. Great Britain. 2016. documentary series

programme.title: New Zealand: Mythical Islands – Wildlife | E02
programme.desc: Viewers have the opportunity to better understand the nature and geographical conditions of the island chain, isolated from other ecosystems. programme.title: Africa: hot life – Lycaons in difficult terrain | E04
programme.desc: Almost all wild inhabitants of hot regions of the world, such as Africa, are at risk of extinction due to climate change. The authors wonder whether and to what extent they will be able to adapt to new, difficult living conditions. Most species living in extreme conditions delay their reproductive cycles; Lycaons speed up this process so that their young are born before the hottest period. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Africa: hot life - Caracals and bush fire | E05
programme.desc: Almost all wild inhabitants of hot regions of the world, such as Africa, are at risk of extinction due to climate change. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.desc: «The Others (2): Spain before Tiquitaca» Before the world baptized Spain as the country of tiqui-taca, before being short didn't matter or goalkeepers knew how to play with their feet, Spanish football lived another reality. Other times marked by wild tackles, mud fields, permissive refereeing, harshness and violence. But they were not necessarily worse times. The Others immerses itself fully in an era unknown to millions of fans and full of incredible stories and characters that belong to a Spanish football that is difficult to recognize today.

programme.title: The Others (T2): Spain before Tiquitaca
programme.desc: «90 years of LaLiga (2019): Messi» Lionel Andrés Messi Cuccittini, known as Leo Messi, is currently considered the best player in the world and one of the best of all time. He is the first footballer in history to have won, among other distinctions, the Ballon d'Or five times, the first four consecutively and five Golden Boots. Since he arrived at the age of 13 at the F.C. Barcelona has not stopped progressing and exhibiting its talent day after day in the Championship, shattering all the records that cross its path. Leo Messi is a living and active legend who, at only 31 years old, is already the all-time top scorer in LaLiga, surpassing myths like Cristiano Ronaldo, Telmo Zarra, Hugo Sánchez or Raúl González Blanco

programme.title: 90 years of stories (T2019): Messi

programme.desc: «Plus+ Report. Mateu Lahoz, behind the referee» Mateu Lahoz is probably the best-known referee in Spain. He has been refereeing for more than three decades, he has been international since 2011 and he was in charge of directing the last Champions League final. Furthermore, he has a very particular way of doing things, which generates as many followers as detractors and which very soon caught the attention of El Día After. But behind the referee is the person, the family, the team... How and why he got to where he is now. Having just turned 45, 'Mateu Lahoz, behind the referee' reviews with the protagonist and his environment (family, friends, assistants) the key moments of a career that has taken him to the top in the refereeing world based on a simple premise: getting to know Toño to better understand Mateu. programme.title: Auto-SOS, the best. Porsche 356
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz head to East London to restore a 1964 Porsche 356 that will be, without a doubt, the worst car they've ever come across. Despite the poor condition the Porsche 356 was in under layers of rust and rot, it remains a top-end sports car legend that Porsche launched into production overnight. The car is owned by 67-year-old former ambulance driver Trevor, who has owned it since the 1980s. It was the car of his dreams, and although Trevor struggled to pay the ever-increasing bills for repairs, the car still had to be parked for a long time in a damp garage. Trevor never gave up the idea of ​​taking it on the road one day, but he was recently diagnosed with advanced prostate cancer, which meant that his hopes of restoring the car were dashed, but his daughters wrote to Tim and Fuzz in the hope that they could help their father get behind the wheel of his beloved car for the last time. Dir.: Stephen Taylor Woodrow, Theo Williams. Led by: Tim Shaw, Fuzz Townshed. USA, UK, 2012, reality show

programme.title: Auto-SOS, the best. Austin-Healy-3000
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz travel to County Durham to recover a 1961 Austin Healy 3000, one of the finest British sports cars produced after the war. The car belongs to former engineer John, who bought it brand new. Already retired, 76-year-old John decided to completely restore his car, spending his savings on it, but he fell ill with Parkinson's disease, so his blue dream was not destined to come true. When the guys delivered the car to the Car SOS workshop, they discovered that John's pride had turned into just a collection of worthless parts. The Healey 3000 was produced between 1959 and 1967 jointly by Austin and Donald Healey Motor Company. Equipped with a 3-liter six-cylinder engine and twin SU carburetors, it produced 124 hp, or 114 mph! Incredibly fast for a car of that time. Dir.: Stephen Taylor Woodrow, Theo Williams. Led by: Tim Shaw, Fuzz Townshed. USA, UK, 2012, reality show

programme.desc: 2016 г. Год: 2016. Страна: JAV. Год: 2016. S1, Ep1 «Brazil Untamed»…At the southern edge of the Pantanal, the world's largest tropical wetland on Earth, there's a placelike no other, and a wildlife so diverse scientists scramble to understand the variety of ways animals interact with each other. The highlands of the Bodoquena Hills are the entrance to the murky wetlands of the Pantanal. Here, the waters are crystal clear, filtered by a limestone formation over 600 million year old, that offers a clear window into the life of these streams. Waterfalls, tufa dams, caves and pristine rivers with a visibility of up to fifty meters abound | The mesmerising wildlife of Brazil is revealed in this fascinating documentary series. Focussing on the Pantanal, the world's largest tropical wetlands, a team of scientists and camera crew study the remarkable creatures that inhabit the area. Predominantly located in the state of Mato Grosso do Sul, though also spreading into Mato Grosso, as well as Bolivia and Paraguay, this unique ecosystem is home to some of Brazil's most captivating species. The team work day and night to track these wonderful animals, including Capuchin monkeys, jaguars, giant otters, maned wolves, capybaras and a wealth of exotic birds | Director: Emmanuelle Wiecha

programme.title: d/s About trees and forests. The invisible world. Western red cedar
programme.desc: In the depths of North American forests, where the sky seems closer and the air is saturated with the freshness of pine needles, grows a majestic tree - the western red cedar. This film will immerse you in a world where nature and history are intertwined into a single whole. France, 2023

programme.title: d/s About trees and forests. The invisible world. Birch of the Far North
programme.desc: On the edge of the inhabited world, where permafrost reigns and polar nights give way to short days, grows one of the hardiest trees on the planet - the birch of the Far North. France, 2023

programme.title: d/s Saving Australian Wildlife. Sandy the Giant Kangaroo
programme.desc: Dr. Bree is worried about Sandy the kangaroo's gas, Smaug the bearded lizard has a bone stuck in his throat, and Willow the owljar has fallen out of her nest. Australia, 2021

programme.title: d/f Is this about love?
programme.desc: The filmmakers delve into the behavior of animals, trying to find out if it is possible for them to feel the same emotions that we do. Particular attention is paid to the mating season of males and the relationship of females with offspring. This research sheds light on whether animals can experience feelings such as love and how their emotions are similar to humans. Dir.: Juan Antonio Rodriguez Llano, Juan Luis Santos. Spain, 2020, drama

programme.title: d/f Marine Mammals: Champions of the Deep
programme.desc: The documentary explores the deep sea, the largest habitat on Earth. On this journey we explore both the shallows and the impressively deep, encountering rare animals and discovering their amazing adaptations that allow them to survive in the realm of the abyss. Find out how these creatures adapted to the extreme conditions of the underwater world and what secrets the sea depths hide. France, 2017

programme.title: d/s Birds: masters of the elements. Fire and water
programme.desc: Birds live in the harshest corners of the planet - from the crater of a volcano to the depths of the sea. The series reveals the unique connection between birds and the four natural elements: air, water, earth and fire. They can withstand winds, overcome oceans, and get food in extreme conditions. But along with nature, they also have to adapt to human influence - the fifth element that they are encountering more and more often. Spain, 2023

programme.title: d/f Superdads of the wild
programme.desc: In the animal world, the role of the male in raising offspring is quite diverse. Most species are characterized by a model in which males do not take part in caring for the young and often are not even aware of their paternity. However, there are exceptions when males become real caring fathers, actively taking part in the upbringing of their offspring. France, 2015

programme.title: Hard working animals. Starlings and oropendula
programme.desc: Shiny starlings are sociable birds: they build their nests next to their neighbors, and little by little a large city with hanging apartments grows up. Their ball-shaped nests are built from intertwined grass and twigs collected near their colony. These houses are woven so well that they can support the weight of an entire family, including three or four chicks, and protect them from the tropical sun and rain. Another outstanding architect is building his house in the forests of Costa Rica: the Oropendola Montezuma or Trucial. Montezuma oropendolas are outstanding builders. They weave their nests from strips of banana leaves. Spain, 2019, educational

programme.title: Hard working animals. Cranes and wild boars
programme.desc: Vast areas of land in the Mediterranean grow nothing but olive trees. But birds and other foraging animals must eat. Their survival depends on olives. Among the collectors of fallen fruits there are some amazing ones. For example, cranes. At dawn, the industrious cranes begin their daily search for food. Birds are cold and need to eat well. At the same time, they spend a lot of precious energy on courtship in the form of dancing and calling. Spain, 2019, educational

programme.title: d/f Wild Land. Kingfisher
programme.desc: The mysterious lands of southern Europe reveal a world where nature retains its original strength and diversity. In these harsh and picturesque landscapes, a variety of inhabitants coexist: the cautious lynx, the majestic imperial eagle, the mighty bear, the swift kingfisher, the mountain goat and the cautious wolf. Spain, 2025

programme.title: d/f The Iberian lynx is the mistress of wild lands. 1 p.
programme.desc: In the Sierra Morena mountains, in the south of the Iberian Peninsula, hides the rarest predator in Europe - the Iberian lynx. This species was once on the verge of extinction, but the efforts of scientists and conservationists gave it a chance for salvation. The film shows the daily life of a lynx family, the struggle for survival, hunting, caring for cubs. Spain, 2024

With their research they will help determine which of the animals is the smartest, most dangerous, strong, fastest and toothiest. A complete set of wildness! How high a bird can fly, who is the most bloodthirsty in the depths of the ocean, and many other stories that will take your breath away. USA, 2012

programme.title: Kieling's Wild World
programme.desc: 30 years of elephant stories - Andreas Kieling accompanies the gentle giants: How are the pachyderms doing in India's rainy season and how do they survive Namibia's extreme drought? (Station info).

programme.title: Kieling's Wild World
programme.desc: Close relatives: Andreas Kieling encounters primates all over the world - from jeladas in Ethiopia to mountain gorillas in Rwanda. Proximity, conflict and survival in an endangered animal world. (Station info).

programme.title: Kieling's Wild World
programme.desc: How do you get wild animals on camera? Andreas Kieling follows the trail of the bears in Canada and the pandas in China - with patience, knowledge and a feeling for the right moment. (Station info).

programme.title: Hautnah Zoo Visit
programme.desc: Bushfires of historic proportions are devastating the country. Taronga Zoo staff are on the frontline fighting to save Australia's wildlife from all-consuming flames. (Station info).

programme.title: Hautnah Zoo Visit
programme.desc: A pregnant female ring-tailed lemur is seriously injured in a fight. Is your unborn baby in danger? Meanwhile, the staff welcomes new arrivals to the zoo, five cute capybaras. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: There is excitement in the elephant enclosure: the 37-year-old elephant Thi Hi Way is becoming a mother. Meanwhile, the atmosphere in the chimpanzee enclosure is thick and a showdown for dominance is imminent. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: Stress for the animal keepers at Chester Zoo: Five Sumatran tigers have to move to a new enclosure. There is also tension among the penguins: Rud and Spike have to separate after 15 years. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: There's a celebration at Chester Zoo. Rotschild giraffe lady Orla has offspring. Her son Kidepo glides into the world from a height of two meters. Meanwhile, keeper Pip is building a nest for endangered frogs. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: A life-threatening virus breaks out in the elephant house. A race against time begins; several animals are already sick. Meanwhile, zebra man Mak has other worries. He should mate. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: The penguin babies were cared for and cared for for six months. Now it's time to swim in the pool with the big boys. Keeper Niall has to solve an incident with the chimpanzees. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: Kitani and Magdani are supposed to mate. But the size and weight of rhinos can be dangerous when breeding. Meanwhile, the orangutans are having offspring. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: There is great anticipation at Chester Zoo because the Grevy's zebra ladies Florence and Nadine are expecting offspring soon. The Asiatic lions Iblis and Kumari, on the other hand, suffer from reproductive problems. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: The dwarf otters Annie and Wallace simply won't let the heavily pregnant deer boar lady Kendari calm down. The guards have no choice but to relocate the troublemakers. (Station info).

programme.title: San Diego Zoo
programme.desc: The zookeepers say goodbye to their beloved pandas Bai-Yun and Xiao Liwu. While the two of them are about to be transported to China, the elephant Tembo has to have his arthritis treated. (Station info).

programme.title: San Diego Zoo
programme.desc: Tiger Meek returns to the San Diego Zoo after a six-year absence. Meanwhile, the tree kangaroos' young hopes rest on the shy marsupial lady Polly. (Station info).

programme.title: San Diego Zoo
programme.desc: While two elephants have to say goodbye to the San Diego Zoo, the park's penguin colony is growing. The three-footed Baird's tapir Felix can look forward to a walking aid. (Station info).

programme.title: San Diego Zoo
programme.desc: Baby elephant Mkhaya learns to use her trunk sensibly. Elsewhere at the San Diego Zoo, two examinations are pending: In addition to the Andean bear Alba, the gorilla Mandazzi is allowed to have a check-up. (Station info).

programme.title: My journey with the elephants
programme.desc: In Botswana, Levison Wood and tracker Kane follow a herd of elephants 400 kilometers from the Chobe River to the Okavango Delta. He experiences the dangers of their migration first hand. (Station info).

programme.title: Big cats
programme.desc: The black-footed cat likes to hunt at night. In South Africa, the team goes in search of the nocturnal big cat. Meanwhile, in Mongolia, a Pallas cat and her offspring are causing a stir. (Station info).

programme.title: Terra Mater
programme.desc: In the USA, the grass pastures of the Northern Great Plains are increasingly being used as agricultural and farmland. Wildlife biologists are now working with farmers to preserve the prairie ecosystem through “open” border fences for bison and pronghorn.

programme.title: Fascination Africa
programme.desc: Due to the relentless drought, the Namib Desert is one of the most hostile places in the world. Inland, the fog is the only way for residents to get water. (Station info).

programme.title: Großkatzen 24/7
programme.desc: Baby Boom in the Delta: The team observes a lioness protecting her cubs in the midst of danger, while a cheetah fights for the survival of her cubs. The leopard also has offspring. (Station info).

programme.title: The giants of the Auckland Islands
programme.desc: Summer on the Auckland Islands near New Zealand: Sea lions defend their territories. Yellow-eyed penguins and albatrosses fight for the survival of their young. (Station info).

programme.title: The Wild Pacific – The Beauty of Life
programme.desc: A sea of ​​records. The Pacific covers a third of the Earth's surface, making it larger than the landmass of all continents and containing half of all water. At up to 11,000 meters, it is the deepest ocean. The fantastic underwater shots by Emmy award-winning cameraman Johnny Friday take you through a parallel universe with rocky cities and their own laws. \n\nIt shows playful sea lions, trusting baby gray whales, dancing schools of sardines and threatening-looking hammerhead sharks. Because the ocean doesn't always live up to its name. It was named the Pacific (“Peaceful Sea”) in November 1520 by its Portuguese explorer Ferdinand Magellan.

programme.title: Cobra and Co – The Deadliest Poisonous Snakes in India
programme.desc: In India, tens of thousands of people die from snake bites every year. Conservationist Romulus Whitaker is looking for ways to help his compatriots and, not least, the reptiles. (Station info).

programme.title: Clever & nimble – the super squirrels
programme.desc: Fluffy, clever and agile – squirrels make hearts beat faster. Their acrobatic skills fascinate scientists around the world. What can people learn from them? (Station info).

programme.title: Big Pacific: The Violent Ocean
programme.desc: In Costa Rica you can marvel at incredible things every year: thousands upon thousands of turtles return to their place of birth to lay eggs, while hundreds of sharks gather on the island of Malpelo. (Station info).

programme.title: The dog rescuers
programme.desc: On the road with Greg and Adella, who save thousands of strays from being euthanized every year in the southern United States.

programme.title: THỬ THÁCH TỘT ĐỘ - EXTREME ENDS
programme.desc: Extreme Ends là một chương trình thực tế phiêu lưu hành động có sự góp mặt của bốn nhân vật nổi tiếng và những vị khách đặc biệt của họ trải nghiệm sự đa dạng của Hồng Kông! Bắt đầu cuộc hành trình cùng hai nghệ sĩ Thái Lan, Gun và Ticha, khi họ khám phá cuộc sống thành phố nhộn nhịp và khám phá vùng ngoại ô thanh bình của Hồng Kông.

programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION
programme.desc: Một chương trình thực tế vui nhộn kể về bốn nam nhân vật nổi tiếng đến từ các quốc gia khác nhau trong một kỳ nghỉ giả tưởng được đài thọ toàn bộ chi phí ở Hồng Kông, được thiết kế riêng cho các “anh em”!

programme.title: ĐIỆP VỤ ĐẢO QUỶ - OPERATION BANGKOK
programme.desc: Cựu quân nhân Wu và cảnh sát chìm Ming giải cứu con tin trên một hòn đảo gần Bangkok. Ngay khi nhiệm vụ hoàn thành và họ chuẩn bị rời đi, Wu phát hiện ra con gái mình cũng đã bị bắt. Quyết tâm cứu cô, anh ở lại cùng Ming để chiến đấu với bọn côn đồ và giải cứu cô.

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ quân nhân ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị Lực lượng Đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thử thách trên bộ, trên biển và trên không. Những nữ quân nhân dự bị hàng đầu thành lập các đội gồm bốn người để thi đấu với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cùng trước sáu người dẫn chương trình nổi tiếng!

programme.title: GIÁO PHÁI BÁO THÙ - WU LIN: THE SOCIETY
programme.desc: Lấy bối cảnh năm 2050, nơi tình trạng ô nhiễm và virus tràn lan buộc mọi người phải đeo khẩu trang chỉ để thở, tuy nhiên cuộc sống hàng ngày vẫn tiếp tục như thường lệ. Khi hàng loạt cái chết bí ẩn nổ ra, cảnh sát nghi ngờ kẻ giết người hàng loạt trong khi có tin đồn về một con quỷ đang nổi cơn thịnh nộ. Giờ đây, cảnh sát phải chạy đua để làm sáng tỏ bí ẩn và ngăn chặn các vụ giết người trước khi sự hoảng loạn bao trùm thành phố.

programme.title: ĐỊCH NHÂN KIỆT VÀ THẤT TÔNG TỘI - DETECTIVE DEE'S SEVEN DEADLY SIN
programme.desc: Thám tử Dee bị lôi kéo vào một loạt vụ giết người làm rung chuyển Đế chế Đường. Kẻ giết người viện đến "Bảy tội lỗi chết người" để biện minh cho ý thức công lý méo mó. Trong nỗ lực không ngừng theo đuổi sự thật, Thám tử Dee đã khám phá ra chiếc mặt nạ của lẽ phải giả tạo và vạch trần bóng tối ẩn giấu bên dưới.

programme.title: THỬ THÁCH TỘT ĐỘ - EXTREME ENDS
programme.desc: Extreme Ends là một chương trình thực tế phiêu lưu hành động có sự góp mặt của bốn nhân vật nổi tiếng và những vị khách đặc biệt của họ trải nghiệm sự đa dạng của Hồng Kông! Bắt đầu cuộc hành trình cùng hai nghệ sĩ Thái Lan, Gun và Ticha, khi họ khám phá cuộc sống thành phố nhộn nhịp và khám phá vùng ngoại ô thanh bình của Hồng Kông.

programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION
programme.desc: Một chương trình thực tế vui nhộn kể về bốn nam nhân vật nổi tiếng đến từ các quốc gia khác nhau trong một kỳ nghỉ giả tưởng được đài thọ toàn bộ chi phí ở Hồng Kông, được thiết kế riêng cho các “anh em”!

Được trang bị lòng dũng cảm và sự khéo léo, Dee đánh bại lũ ma cà rồng khát máu và cuối cùng vạch trần tham vọng đen tối của hoàng tử.

programme.title: QUYẾT ĐẤU LỤC NHĨ MỸ HẦU - THE MACAQUE MONKEY
programme.desc: Thế giới hỗn loạn sau khi cây sự sống bị đốt cháy. Tôn Ngộ Không quyết định quay về quá khứ để hồi sinh nó, nhưng thần lực của anh không ổn định sau khi mất chiếc vòng vàng, và anh phải tìm lại bản thân lúc trẻ để hợp sức tìm kiếm sức mạnh thời gian. Vì Khỉ Macaque sáu tai cũng muốn có sức mạnh của thời gian nên chúng đụng độ nhau trong một trận chiến khốc liệt…
